programs.title: Terry McMillan Presents: Preach, Pray, Love
programs.desc: Sparks fly when rapper Charlie Jones crosses paths with Kyrus Owens, a charismatic minister. As their romance blossoms, Owens' congregation begins to question his commitment to the church, while Charlie struggles to reconcile her edgy public image.

programs.title: Love, Again
programs.desc: Caroline and Henry's nearly perfect life shifts dramatically when Henry is diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's disease. As her soulmate gradually slips away, Caroline soon finds unexpected solace when she develops a friendship with Leo.

programs.title: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
programs.desc: Al and Lisa Robertson's relationship becomes strained under the weight of betrayal and unspoken pain. With their marriage and faith hanging by a thread, both must decide if love is worth fighting for, and what it truly means to forgive.

programs.title: Faith in the Flames: The Nichole Jolly Story
programs.desc: Nichole Jolly is a nurse who clocks in for her shift at the local hospital in Paradise, Calif. When a raging wildfire engulfs the town and forces an evacuation, she risks her own life to bring her husband, children and other residents to safety.
